title: Graduation Day
paragraphs: Today is a big day for Omar.
It is his graduation day.
Omar wakes up early.
He puts on his new suit and looks in the mirror.
He smiles.
"Four years of hard work… and now it's finished!"
His mother is in the kitchen.
She is very happy.
"My son is a graduate today!" she says.
At the university, there are many students and families.
Everyone is excited.
Omar sees his best friend, Karim.
Karim graduated two years ago.
Now he works in a call center.
"Congratulations, Omar!" says Karim.
"I'm proud of you."
The ceremony begins.
The students wait for their names.
Omar feels nervous.
Then he hears: "Omar Adel!"
He walks to the stage and takes his certificate.
His father stands up and claps.
His mother has tears in her eyes.
They are happy tears.
After the ceremony, the family goes to a restaurant to celebrate.
They eat, laugh and take many photos.
Then his father asks a question: "So, Omar… what's next?"
Omar stops smiling.
He doesn't have an answer.
He has a degree, but he doesn't have a job.
And many companies ask for one thing: good English.
That night, Omar can't sleep.
He thinks about his future.
Then he opens his laptop and types: "Jobs for fresh graduates."
His journey starts now.

questions.q: Why is today a big day for Omar?
questions.a: Because it is his graduation day.

questions.q: Who is Karim, and what does he do?
questions.a: Karim is Omar's best friend. He works in a call center.

questions.q: How does Omar feel before he hears his name?
What question does his father ask?

questions.a: Because he is thinking about his future. He has a degree, but he doesn't have a job.

questions.q: Do you remember an important day in your life? How did you feel?
questions.a: Example: Yes. My graduation day was very important. I felt happy and a little nervous.
